title: Velvety Algerian Potato Tagine
description: A spicy and comforting Algerian dish featuring potatoes in a rich and velvety sauce, made with a flambe technique and suitable for lacto-vegetarian diets.
instructions: Heat the oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the potatoes, tomato paste, and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Use a kitchen torch to flambe the top of the dish, or place it under the broiler for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs or crusty bread.
